# `sngl test --platform=X` is a build for X, whatever the source's `output`
# block names. The block below names html only; gtk4 still has to see its own
# platform package, or `vbox` -- which gtk4 renders only through the override
# in its platform package -- is reported as a component gtk4 does not
# implement, and every test in the file is skipped.

[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 development libraries required'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'does not implement'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component greeter node {
    var name = "world"
    vbox {
        text(value=name)
    }
}

func testGreeterRenders(t Test, c greeter) {
    t.assert(c.name == "world")
}

window {
}
-- testrun/gtk4/go/app.sngl/greeter/1 --
sha256:c559afadadbc21389156271c16d138ed
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "GreeterRenders",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ]
}
